paragraphs: R' Judah, his son (in R' Akiva’s time) — Sheviit, chapter 5, halakhah 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ה ה״ב gives chapter 5, halakhah 2. The format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but the source does not explicitly name the corpus or an edition.

Judah is presented as Isaiah the Perfumer’s son. ר״ע is completed contextually as Akiva, while its personal-title component remains R', as does Judah’s abbreviated title. No teacher relationship is added to the temporal phrase.
